agent_explanation: Shrunk to single bouncing ball (r=0.5,m=1,e=0.9) falling under gravity onto arena floor (implicit boundary). Energy is conserved ~57.76 J until impact. Between step 62 (y=0.508, vy=-10.27) and step 63 (y=0.5, vy=+12.34) collision response injects energy: rebound speed / incident speed = 12.34/10.27 ≈1.20 exceeds declared restitution 0.9, so kinetic energy jumps from ~57.76 to 81.03 J (+40%), exceeding 10%+5J tolerance (limit 68.55). Likely collision impulse and/or positional correction adds velocity instead of scaling by e, or gravity impulse is double-counted in substep, causing super-elastic bounce.
